transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's a burning feeling when I pass water, and I keep needing to go much more often than usual.
When did you first notice it?
It started a little while back, I'm not too sure exactly when.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
I can't say I've noticed anything making it better or worse, really.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
It's a stinging, burning sort of feeling when I go, quite uncomfortable.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
It's just down below when I'm passing water. It doesn't spread anywhere else.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
It's not too bad, I'd say it's manageable. I can put up with it.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
It's mainly when I'm actually passing water, not so much in between.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?
Yes, my water looks a bit cloudy and smells stronger than usual. I haven't seen any blood though.
Do you see a doctor regularly for any health condition?
Yes, I have an underactive thyroid, so I'm on tablets for that.
Which medicines do you take regularly, including any new ones?
I take a tablet each morning for my thyroid, and one once a week for my thin bones. I also use a cream from the hospital twice a week, but I can't remember what it's called.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
Yes, I'm allergic to trimethoprim — it gave me an itchy rash.
Has this changed what you can do around the house or outside?
I've stopped going to the residents' coffee morning, in case I can't reach a toilet in time.
Is there anything about this that worries you?
I think it's another water infection, like the one I had before. I'm hoping to get some antibiotics before the weekend.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
